FEAT-1-STORY-39.title: Provider Search Request/Response Schema Validation
FEAT-1-STORY-39.description: Define and enforce strict Pydantic schemas for provider search inputs and outputs, including specialty queries, location filters, and structured provider result payloads to ensure contract consistency across tool_router and facade layers.

FEAT-1-STORY-40.title: Vector Search and Taxonomy Fallback Orchestration Logic Hardening
FEAT-1-STORY-40.description: Enhance provider_search_service to robustly execute vector search with deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based search when embeddings fail or return low-confidence results, ensuring stable ranking and deduplication.

FEAT-1-STORY-41.title: Location Filtering and FIPS/County Resolution Validation
FEAT-1-STORY-41.description: Validate and enforce multi-stage location filtering logic including state, city, and county resolution using FIPS mapping, ensuring accurate geographic narrowing of provider results.

FEAT-1-STORY-42.title: Provider Search Observability and Debug Logging
FEAT-1-STORY-42.description: Instrument provider search flow with debug_logger to capture query inputs, embedding usage, fallback triggers, and result counts for traceability and production diagnostics.
